title: A novel IR-SRGAN assisted super-resolution evaluation of photothermal coherence tomography for impact damage in toughened thermoplastic CFRP laminates under room temperature and low temperature
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical and engineering evaluation of impact damage in composite materials using infrared thermography and generative adversarial networks (IR-SRGAN). It does not evaluate or discuss religious, spiritual, moral, or ethical topics.
